Regional lymphatic vessels in UBERON use the pattern '{region} lymphatic vessel' (e.g., facial lymphatic vessel, pectoral lymphatic vessel). Consider using 'radial lymphatic vessel' as primary label and keeping 'radial lymphatic channel' as a synonym to match source data.
